title: Addition law for the quadratic bit
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $x,z\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, where $\mathbb{F}_2$ is the field with two elements. The complete quadratic bit of $x+z$ equals the sum of the complete quadratic bits of $x$ and $z$ plus $\sum_{i<j}(x_i z_j+z_i x_j)$, with all operations in $\mathbb{F}_2$.
